candidates.exact_span: The facility shall have a 1-year compliance schedule to achieve final limitations for Cyanide pollutant.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether cyanide is governed by interim compliance-schedule limitations versus final numeric limits during Federal FY2025 affects which enforceable limit applies for comparison and how interim or missing cyanide results are classified.

candidates.exact_span: The permit will require compliance schedule reports.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpreting compliance schedule reports as a distinct monitoring or reporting obligation affects whether such submissions were required during FY2025 and how absent schedule-report evidence is categorized.

candidates.exact_span: The preliminary toxic analysis, also, shows potential for RP to exist, based on insufficiently sensitive test methods used, for Cadmium, 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin, Pentachlorophenol, Aldrin, Chlordane and Toxaphene pollutants.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Reasonable-potential findings for these parameters bear on whether numeric discharge limits are imposed and whether associated monitoring obligations are triggered for Federal FY2025.

candidates.exact_span: Because the permittee has not met the sufficient sensitive test requirement per 40 CFR 122.21(e)(3), EPA proposes monitoring for these parameters quarterly n the draft permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether draft-proposed quarterly monitoring for the listed parameters is actually required during Federal FY2025 changes monitoring-obligation evaluation and how missing quarterly results are interpreted.

candidates.exact_span: During the public comment period, the permittee may submit the analysis results using EPA approved methods with SSM complied MDL (shown in parenthesis) for Cadmium (0.05 ug/L, EPA 200.9) , 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin (1.0E-5 ug/L, EPA 1613B), Pentachlorophenol (7.4 ug/L, EPA 604), Aldrin (0.004 ug/L, EPA 608), Chlordane (0.014 ug/L, EPA 608), and Toxaphene (0.24 ug/L, EPA 608)). EPA would reconsider this monitoring requirement for the final permit if the result(s) indicate no reasonable potential exists.
candidates.computation_change_reason: A conditional pathway exists where submission of sufficiently sensitive method results during the comment period could eliminate proposed quarterly monitoring; interpreting whether that condition was met affects required-monitoring status and missing-evidence classification for these parameters.

candidates.exact_span: Pollutants that have the Navajo Nation WQS reported above MQL are Aluminum, Arsenic, Copper, Total Mercury, Nickel, Selenium, Zinc, Bis(2-ethylhexyl)Phthalate, Chloroform, Phenol, Cyanide and Arsenic.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The enumerated parameters are identified as having water-quality-based limit derivation basis; different interpretation of which parameters are in scope changes applicable numeric limits and related monitoring expectations.
